notes.title: Race Jam Demo Update 5
notes.content:
[p][b]RACE JAM DEMO UPDATE 5
[/b]Hey everyone! Update 5 is here with a major focus on physics, Chase Mode AI upgrades, and big menu overhauls. We’ve also introduced some early changes to Stunt Mode for you to try out, along with several key bug fixes across vehicles, tracks, and multiplayer. Here’s what’s new:[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Physics Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Reduced Floatiness:[/b] Vehicles now stay grounded much more realistically.[/p][/*][*][p][b]No More Flying Cars:[/b] Fixed issue where vehicles could start flying when rotated.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bounce Physics Fixed:[/b] After big jumps, vehicles will properly bounce if they don’t land on their wheels.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Cops AI Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Better Chase Speeds:[/b] Police now approach players at more reasonable speeds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]More Realistic Driving:[/b] Cop driving behavior adjusted for smoother pursuit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dispatcher Added:[/b] Police radio announcements now play during Chase mode.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Menus & UI Overhaul[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Button Guides:[/b] Each menu page now displays clear button help.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Highlighting:[/b] Buttons now stand out more when selected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Profile Indicator:[/b] New profile display added to the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Track Menu Reworked:[/b] Layout and navigation streamlined.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Options Menu Remade:[/b] Completely redesigned for clarity and ease of use.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Locked Items Notice:[/b] Vehicle select now shows when a locked item is chosen.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Stunt Mode (Experimental)[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Boost & Hop System:[/b] Added 1 ground boost and 1 hop per stunt attempt.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vehicle Downforce Fixed:[/b] Tuna Extreme, Frizzy, and Mason now match the downforce of other vehicles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reset Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Vehicles no longer reset while already resetting.[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicles no longer take damage while resetting if colliding with walls.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Split-Screen Multiplayer Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Health Bar Fix:[/b] Players will no longer see their own health bar above their vehicle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]HUD Scaling:[/b] HUD elements now properly resize for each player.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks again for all the feedback and time you’ve put into the demo. It’s a huge help in making Race Jam the best it can be. We hope you’re enjoying it as much as we are, and we’ll have more updates coming your way soon![/p][p][b]— The Team at DiffGames[/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Race Jam Demo Update 4
notes.content:
[p][b]RACE JAM DEMO UPDATE 4
[/b]Hey everyone! Update 4 is here with a big focus on AI improvements, track tweaks, and behind-the-scenes polish. As we continue refining the new speed systems and gameplay flow, this patch addresses both visible and under-the-hood upgrades across the board. Here is what’s new:[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]AI & Gameplay Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Smarter Opponents:[/b] AI logic for opponent vehicles has been improved for tighter, more competitive races.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better Cops:[/b] Police vehicle AI now handles high-speed chases more intelligently.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spinout Fix:[/b] Rear wheel colliders adjusted across all vehicles to reduce unintentional spinouts.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Collect Mode Fix:[/b] Opponents now spawn in proper starting positions during Collect mode.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lap Counter Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where laps wouldn’t increase when crossing the finish line.

[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Track Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Triassic Track Overhaul:[/b] Turns reworked to better support higher top speeds.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Animation Cleanup:[/b] Removed unnecessary animation keyframes on Triassic Track for improved performance.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lighting Pass:[/b] Lighting rebuilt on all tracks for better visual consistency.

[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Menus & UI Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Vehicle Select Rebuilt:[/b] Entire Vehicle Select menu redesigned for clarity and smoother functionality.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Button Help Added:[/b] All menus now display clear button function explanations.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multiplayer Menu Fixes:[/b] Improved layout and functionality for all multiplayer-related screens.

[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Performance & Optimization:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]VRAM Usage Lowered:[/b] Final tracks optimized to reduce VRAM usage and improve load times.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Menu Texture Optimization:[/b] Texture sizes on menu screens significantly reduced for better memory usage.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Frame Cleanup:[/b] Removed duplicate frames in menu videos to smooth playback.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Asset Cleanup:

[/b][/p][list][*][p]All tracks purged of unused asset references.

[/p][/*][*][p]Unused HUD elements removed.

[/p][/*][*][p]Texture sizes are reduced wherever possible across environments and menus.

[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Thanks again to all of you putting time into the demo, submitting feedback, and helping us push Race Jam forward. Stay tuned, as more updates and new features are on the way![/p][p]— [b]The Team at DiffGames[/b] [/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Race Jam Demo Update 3
notes.content:
[p][b]RACE JAM DEMO UPDATE 3
[/b]Hey everyone! As we continue fixing bugs and working on the new speed and physics settings, we’ve rolled out an update focused on performance, optimization, and polish. Update 3 is all about cleaning up behind-the-scenes systems and delivering a smoother ride across the board. Here's what's new:[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Performance & Optimization:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New Compression System:[/b] All game files have been recompressed using a new technique.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Massive Size Reduction:[/b] Demo file size dropped from [b]21GB to just 4GB[/b].

[/p][/*][*][p][b]VRAM Optimization:[/b] Menu screens now use [b]50% less VRAM[/b], improving load times and performance on lower-end systems.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Texture Optimization:[/b] Reduced texture load on [b]NY Highway[/b], [b]Hedgehog Hills[/b], and [b]LA Freeway[/b] for better performance.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Gameplay & Vehicle Adjustments:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Stunt Vehicle Resize:[/b] All stunt vehicles resized for better camera framing and gameplay feel.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Speed Overhaul:[/b] All multiplayer and stunt vehicles rebalanced to match updated speed systems.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]AI Improvements:

[/b][/p][list][*][p]Opponent vehicles now use speed boosts more effectively.

[/p][/*][*][p]Police AI behavior improved to better handle faster gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Settings & Controls:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New Setting:[/b] VSync toggle now available in Options menu.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mouse Toggle:[/b] You can now toggle the mouse cursor on or off from the main menus.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Keyboard Support:[/b] You can now type when entering your [b]profile name[/b] or [b]racekit name[/b] without any issues.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Menu & UI Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Challenge Menu:[/b] Fixed a bug that prevented proper access to challenges.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]D-Pad Input:[/b] Now fully functional on all menus.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Space Bar Fix:[/b] Space bar now properly selects menu items.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loading Screen:[/b] Reorganized layout for improved clarity and aesthetics.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks again to everyone who's been supporting Race Jam and helping us shape the future of the game. Jump back into the demo and let us know what you think! Your feedback helps us keep racing forward![/p][p]— The Team at DiffGames[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Race Jam Demo Update 2
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! We’ve been hard at work making improvements to the Race Jam demo following all the awesome feedback from players like you. This update brings some big overhauls, major performance upgrades, and a number of bug fixes that should make everything smoother, faster, and more fun. Here's what’s new:[/p][p][b]Track Updates & Overhauls:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Joe’s Room:[/b] Increased size of slide entrance for better flow.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hedgehog Hills:[/b] Fully renovated, with both U-turns removed and most turns widened for smoother navigation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Triassic Track:[/b] Terrain issues resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Temple:[/b] Complete rework underway—expect tighter visuals and cleaner racing lines.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NY Highway:[/b] Major resize—track is now 65% larger! Physics materials on walls updated to prevent vehicles from sticking.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay & Vehicle Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Drifting:[/b] Reworked to feel less sticky and far smoother overall.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Speed:[/b] All vehicles now have +30 MPH added to their top speed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Traction Control:[/b] Reduced the slowing effect significantly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]ESP and Traction Helper:[/b] Both disabled for a more skill-based driving experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steering Sensitivity:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Keyboard steering now works correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum sensitivity increased from 15 to 45 for more fine-tuned control.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Performance & Visuals:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Lighting:[/b] Recalculated lighting across all tracks to boost performance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Setting:[/b] Added the option to enable VSync.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI & Menu Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Vehicle Select:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Back button now works properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the vehicle select screen was being skipped.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Profiles:[/b] Players at level 40 can now finish races without issue.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlocking Fixes:[/b] Fixed an issue that prevented suspension and other body parts from unlocking properly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character Unlocks:[/b] Bug preventing new character unlocks has been resolved.

[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Localization:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Languages:[/b] Temporarily disabled all languages except English and Spanish while we work with professional translators to improve the rest.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localization Menu:[/b] Fixed several menu bugs related to language selection.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again to everyone who’s played the demo and submitted feedback! We’re working hard to make Race Jam the best it can be. Try the updated demo on Steam, and don’t forget to share your thoughts with us on Discord or Steam discussions![/p][p]— The Team at DiffGames[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: RACE JAM DEMO UPDATE 1
notes.content:
[p]Over the last couple of weeks we have rolled out a number of updates for the Race Jam demo, addressing a ton of issues reported during Steam Next Fest. Thanks for all the feedback and support! Here’s a quick update of what was changed. 

[b]Fixes and Improvements: [/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Loadout Buttons[/b] now highlight properly[/p][/*][*][p][b]Taxi[/b] traffic car no longer randomly disappears on LA Freeway[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue that prevented items from unlocking correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected [b]collision toggle[/b] logic (can’t ignore collision with self).[/p][/*][*][p]Camera properly locked in place when using Bandicoot[b] [/b]Camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple [b]menu UI bugs[/b] have been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reset points[/b] now behave correctly in the LA Freeway pillar section.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where[b] camera[/b] would clip through the ground when landing after a big jump.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hole in barriers[/b] on [i]Jeff’s Turnpike[/i] patched.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Gameplay Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New Profile Flow.[/b] Players who haven’t unlocked race kits will now only select their vehicle. Character and Perk selection is now exclusive to race kit setup. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Charge Boosts. [/b]The charge boost meter now only resets when all 4 wheels leave the ground instead of one. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Repair[/b]. Repairing only stops when all 4 wheels leave the ground instead of one.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Audio Updates: [/b][/p][list][*][p]Lowered default music and SFX volume.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new SFX when landing vehicles. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed RB spawn sound to be more noticeable. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]police siren[/b] volume levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]spike strip SFX[/b] continuing after finishing Coffee Run.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Vehicle and Track Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed bridge that players could clip through on the NY Highway track. [/p][/*][*][p]Spike Strip now has more weight to prevent it from moving all around the track. [/p][/*][*][p]Mason’s hood camera raised for better visibility. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Low Gear Boosting Tweaks:[/b][/p][list][*][p]When at speeds under 130mph vehicles will accelerate 50% faster[/p][/*][*][p]The goal with this tweek is to make mistakes less punishing.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]VIP max speed increased from 178 - 188 mph.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for all your help testing! And if you haven’t already or would like to test the changes yourself, try the demo on Steam and let us know what you think on our Discord or through Steam. [/p][p]- The Team at Diffgames [/p]
